name: Winterhoof Water Well
summary: Winterhoof Water Well faces a threat to Mulgore’s water supply from the Venture Company. South of Bloodhoof Village, it stands at the edge of the Rolling Plains, where tauren tribes and roaming herds depend on its fresh water.

sections.title: A Threatened Lifeline
sections.body: Deep wells sustain Mulgore’s herds and tauren encampments. Winterhoof Water Well draws from aquifers beneath the Rolling Plains and takes its name from one of the plains’ respected tribes. Now the Venture Company has targeted this vital source. The goblin cartel seeks control of the surrounding territory and has tried to poison the water.

sections.title: Purification and Defense
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn has made sacred totems to counter the Venture Company’s toxins and restore the well’s balance. The tauren’s young braves must help cleanse it. For the tauren, protecting the well means survival and the duty to keep the earth and its waters free from corruption.

faq.q: Where is the Winterhoof Water Well located?
faq.answer: Winterhoof Water Well lies in southern Mulgore, south of Bloodhoof Village at the edge of the Rolling Plains.

faq.q: Who poisoned the Winterhoof Water Well?
faq.answer: The Venture Company poisoned Winterhoof Water Well to control local resources and weaken the tauren.

faq.q: How can the poisoned well be cleansed?
faq.answer: Mull Thunderhorn crafted an enchanted totem whose primal magic purges the Venture Company’s toxins from the water.

faq.q: Why are water wells so sacred to the tauren?
aliases: why do tauren care about wells
faq.answer: Tauren rely on water for their tribes and roaming herds, and see it as a gift from the Earth Mother. Poisoning it threatens their lives and offends their faith.

angles.text: As a tauren, you face an early trial in defending and purifying ancestral wells as you protect the land from outside exploitation.
As a shaman, you bring elemental harmony to the well’s cleansing and see how totems can heal wounded water spirits.
